spans.s: (?) m. (= सं-दंश) a pair of tongs or nippers, L.
flying together (one of the modes of flight attributed to birds), MBh.
a partic. mode of flight (a combination of prec. and उड्-डीन, ‘flying up’; accord. to some ‘flying well’), ib.
(perhaps w.r. for सं-जीविन्, q.v.) N. of a minister of the crow-king Megha-varṇa, Kathās.
